Feeling bad about yourself, a failure, o.evidence:
Honestly, the first thing that hits me is a wave of pure panic, like I'm suddenly trapped in a tiny box with no door. But right after that, my brain starts screaming at me: *"You're going to pass out again. You're going to faint on this test and everyone will see."*

It's so irrational because I know I'm capable—I remember passing out while giving blood years ago, but that memory feels like a curse now. Instead of relaxing about it, it just makes me hyper-aware of my body shaking or my breathing getting shallow. It feels like I can't unhear my own heart beating so loud; every thump seems to echo in my ears. And then comes the physical sensation where everything gets cold, my vision blurs slightly, and that sick feeling in my stomach kicks in before anything else happens. It feels like my body is betraying me even though I know logically that nothing bad is happening.
